#include <iostream>
#include <string>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

class LittleCLoves3II {
public:
    void solve() {
        long long n, m;
        cin >> n >> m;
        
        if (n > m) {
            long long t = n;
            n = m;
            m = t;
        }
        
        if (n == 1) {
            long long q = m / 6;
            long long r = m % 6;
            long long ans = q * 6 + (r > 3 ? (r - 3) * 2 : 0);
            cout << ans << endl;
            return;
        }
        
        if (n == 2) {
            if (m == 2) {
                cout << 0 << endl;
            } else if (m == 3) {
                cout << 4 << endl;
            } else if (m == 7) {
                cout << 12 << endl;
            } else {
                cout << n * m << endl;
            }
            return;
        }
        
        long long total = n * m;
        cout << total - (total % 2) << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    LittleCLoves3II solver;
    solver.solve();
    return 0;
}
